costs.note: Mock usage uses the mock provider's token estimate; cost follows the resolved model manifest, which is free for the example models.

limitations: The mock provider serves scripted responses; these metrics validate the harness and suite, not model quality.
Small suite (n=12); treat this as a development smoke result, not a quality claim.
Routing n=12 is below the 200-case guidance; per-class and calibration numbers are indicative only.
Wall-clock latency includes harness overhead and varies between runs; it is excluded from the determinism fingerprint.
Calibration bins and the threshold sweep are descriptive on the evaluated partition; v0 does not fit temperature scaling or hold out a calibration split.
Oracle labels came from 'synthetic-authored'; they are authored labels and were not independently re-labeled.

labeling.ambiguity_rule: Mark a request ambiguous when both the coding and storytelling menus plausibly fit and no single detail clearly dominates. Ambiguous cases are excluded from oracle agreement and calibration, and are reported through abstain precision and recall.
labeling.notes: v0 labels are authored by the suite author rather than produced by running every child. T-0021 owns measured oracle labeling. Zero marginal cost because no extra calls were made.

calibration.notes: Descriptive only. The suite is too small for a fit/eval calibration split; no temperature scaling is applied.
calibration.partition: descriptive: all non-ambiguous cases for the threshold sweep; answered (routed) cases for reliability bins. No fit/eval split or temperature scaling in v0.
